speaker: CURTIS
description: Curtis is a seventeen-year-old young adult male with a charismatic, warm, and resonant vocal timbre that possesses a natural depth. His delivery is refined yet fierce, spoken at a steady, confident pace with an earnest, polite, and noble emotional baseline. While encouraging, warm, and cooperative in everyday interaction, his voice shifts to an urgent, gritty, and passionate intensity during combat.
ref_text: I can hardly call myself a prince now that the three kings and queens have dismissed their titles and become the Council. Just call me Curtis.
